name: oa-sdk
description: OpenAPI 3.2 management monorepo — modular schemas, codegen bridge, mock server

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/openapi-projection-contract build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/parser build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/router build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/client build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/codegen build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/mock-server build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/typia-mock build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/markdown-editor build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/openapi-projection-contract test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/core test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/parser test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/router test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/client test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/codegen test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/mock-server test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/typia-mock test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/personas test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/markdown-editor test && corepack pnpm --filter playground test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/openapi-projection-contract typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/core typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/parser typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/router typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/client typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/codegen typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/mock-server typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/typia-mock typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/personas typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/markdown-editor typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter playground typecheck
scripts.schema:validate: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/parser build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/codegen build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/schemas run validate && node packages/codegen/dist/cli/index.js validate --spec packages/schemas/src/.merged.yaml --require-32
scripts.schema:validate:openapi: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/parser build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/codegen build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/schemas run validate:openapi && node packages/codegen/dist/cli/index.js validate --spec packages/schemas/src/.merged.yaml --require-32
scripts.build:scripts: tsup scripts/spec-diff.ts scripts/check-api-index.ts --format esm --outDir scripts/dist --clean --platform node --external execa --external yaml --external @oa-sdk/mock-server
scripts.check:dpm-surface: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm run smoke:subpaths && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm run smoke:consumer-workflow && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm run smoke:pack
